newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai has largest housing growth in China.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai has largest housing growth in China.

text.p: Shanghai has demolished 12 million sq metres of old houses and apartments and built 40 million sq metres of new housing since 1992, giving the city the highest rate of housing growth in China, the Liberation Daily said on Thursday.
The average living space per person in Shanghai rose to eight sq metres per person, up from 6.6 sq metres in 1992, the paper said.
Housing investment from local governments has declined since 1992, while investment from overseas sources has risen, accounting for one quarter of the home construction since 1992, said the paper.
Shanghai, one of China's most overcrowded cities, faces a huge housing problem with much of the existing housing stock old and decrepit.
